claude.result:
Saved to `./game.html` (108 KB, single file, one `<style>` + one `<script>`, no external resources).

**What's in it**

| # | System | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core loop | One `S` state object; mulberry32 whose 32-bit state lives *inside* `S` (so saves capture the RNG); 12-step documented turn order shown in the Map and Dev panels |
| 2 | Map | 8×8, seeded terrain (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins), 15 buildings with terrain gates and adjacency bonuses surfaced in tooltips |
| 3 | Economy | Real chains: ash→soil→food (composter→greenhouse), ore+power→metal (forge), metal+power→parts. Inputs gate output proportionally; caps clamp and log overflow; power decays 20%/turn |
| 4–5 | People/Needs | Named colonists, 4 jobs, skill 1–5 with xp, fatigue, morale. Output = job match × skill × morale × fatigue × automation. Morale 0 ⇒ refuses to work; 3 turns at 0 ⇒ leaves (recoverable) |
| 6 | Research | 13 nodes, prereq DAG, scrip+parts, lab discount; unlocks Cistern + Fungal Vat, changes yields and storm damage |
| 7 | Events | 14 events, **6** with 2–3 choices; all mutate state; 8-turn cooldowns |
| 8 | Trade | Caravan every ~7 turns, 2-turn stay, limited stock *and* limited purse; price = base × drifting global walk × local scarcity × charter |
| 9 | Hazard | Storms every 5 turns, severity scales with turn; damaged buildings go to zero output; repairs cost parts **and** a colonist's shift |
| 10–12 | Save/UI | JSON in/out of a textarea with field-by-field validation errors; 6 tabs, Space/1–6 keys, tooltips on every number including modifier provenance, 360px-safe, state shown by text+symbol not color alone |
| 13 | Dev | **32 assertions** and a 200-turn greedy-policy benchmark printing summary stats + FNV-1a state hash |

**Verification status — please read**

I could not execute anything. `node --version` runs, but every actual invocation (`node -e`, heredoc, file arg, and one attempt with the sandbox override) came back `This command requires approval`, which was not granted. So **the test suite and benchmark have not been run** — they are verified by inspection only, and I won't claim otherwise.

What I did instead: a full line-by-line read of the script, which caught and fixed six real defects — a malformed CSS declaration (`#e8c martial`) and a malformed border color, an off-by-one in the water projection (`S.turn+1` where `stepStorm` tests `S.turn`), a crash path in test 5 when a seed produced no water tile, a test-31 loop that could be kept alive by migrant events, and sick colonists silently reverting after assignment. I also raised starting stock (metal 36 / parts 14 / food-water 28) because a hand-traced opening showed the first-10-turn food and water curves were negative with no metal left to correct them.

To verify, open the file and hit **Dev → Run Tests** and **Run Benchmark** (twice — the hash must match). If you'd like me to run it here, approve a `node` command and I'll paste the real output.
